title: Learnings from curating a trustworthy, well-annotated, and useful dataset of disordered English speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methodologies for curating and annotating a speech dataset for individuals with speech disorders. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics; its mention of 'trustworthiness' and 'diversity' refers to data quality and representative sampling for speech recognition performance.
